source_locator.edition_or_translation: J. M. Ashmand translation from Proclus's Greek paraphrase; 1900 W. Foulsham & Co. new edition
source_locator.short_quote: its influence is strengthened chiefly when it may be oriental, swift and direct in its proper course and motion ... when occidental and slow in motion or retrograde

normalized_rule: Classify a planet's influence as strengthened chiefly when it is oriental, swift, and direct, and weakened when it is occidental, slow, or retrograde.
synthesis_notes: This is a source-specific traditional influence classification, not a modern physics or performance claim.
review_notes: Keep this motion/orientation rule distinct from the separate angular-position strength rules and from later essential/accidental dignity systems.
transmission_notes: The contrast is stated in the Ashmand/Proclus main text. Editorial footnotes 65 and 66 offer later explanations and are not imported as additional conditions.
